title: Google Meet integration (Calendar & Video Conferencing) | Xobin
text:
About Google Meet
Google Meet is Google's video conferencing service, built into Google Workspace and Google Calendar. Every scheduled event can carry a secure meeting link that participants join from a browser or mobile app.
Why Integrate Google Meet with Xobin?
Integrating Google Meet with Xobin lets you schedule, manage and conduct interviews inside your hiring workflow. It enables automatic calendar updates, customisable time slots and direct access to Google Meet links, saving time and delivering a smooth candidate experience.
How to Integrate Google Meet with Xobin
Connect your Google account
Log in to your Xobin dashboard.
In the left-side menu click
Interviews
Select the option to connect your Google account.
Sign in and grant Xobin permission to view, edit and share calendar events.
Once permissions are granted the integration is complete.
Configure availability
Set interview durations such as 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes, or a custom duration.
Create an event through Xobin with the event name, candidate name and candidate email.
Choose whether the candidate selects a time slot or the interview is scheduled immediately.
Schedule the event
If the candidate does not select a slot, choose a date and time to schedule instantly.
Once scheduled you can copy the event link, or cancel and reschedule the event within Xobin.
Access and conduct the interview
The scheduled event appears in your Google Calendar timeline.
Click the event to view all details.
Use the
Join Google Meet
button to open the meeting and conduct the interview.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is designed for recruiters, hiring managers and HR professionals who want to streamline interview scheduling and management. It suits teams looking for a seamless way to coordinate interviews, reduce manual effort and improve candidate engagement.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Meet links on every interview
Scheduled Xobin interviews carry a Google Meet link, joinable from the calendar event or the Xobin dashboard.
Flexible durations
Pick 15, 30, 45 or 60 minute slots, or set a custom duration for longer panel interviews.
Candidate self-scheduling
Send availability and let candidates choose a slot, or schedule the interview instantly yourself.
Copy, cancel or reschedule
Copy the event link to share, or cancel and reschedule the interview directly within Xobin.
Nothing to configure per interview
A Meet room is generated with the calendar event, so there is no separate conferencing setup step.
Join from browser or mobile
Candidates and interviewers join straight from the link, no downloads or accounts required.
